title: ClientSample
description: One row of client/samples: self-monitoring of the load generator or the TLS relay, once a second, input to the client_bound check.

stage_index.description: Stage running at sampled_at; absent during warmup and cooldown.

goroutines.description: Goroutine count of the sampled process.

in_flight_requests.description: Requests sent and not yet finished.

send_lag_max_seconds.description: Largest send lag (sent_at minus scheduled_at) in the sample interval.

send_lag_p99_seconds.description: p99 send lag in the sample interval.

worker.description: Worker or shard, matching the request record's worker.
